entities.summary: "Wild West Hero" is a song by Electric Light Orchestra (ELO), and the closing track and third single from the album Out of the Blue. The song was written reputedly by lead singer Jeff Lynne in four minutes while on holiday. Melvyn Gale, normally the band's cellist, provided the Western-style piano for this track.
